reasoning_content: Interesting! The created project uses `openculturas/openculturas-distribution` version 3.1.3 from GitHub (the public mirror). This is a release version (3.1.3), whereas the workspace commit is 3.0.x-dev. The 3.1.3 release may have the bug fixed (adding a geocoder dependency to openculturas_openstreetmap). Let me check the info file of the distribution inside example.org.

action.command:
cd /workspace/example.org
P=web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-distribution
echo "=== version ==="; grep -m1 "version" $P/openculturas.info.yml
echo "=== openstreetmap deps in installed copy ==="; awk '/^dependencies:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' $P/modules/custom/openculturas_openstreetmap/openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml 2>/dev/null
echo "=== is openstreetmap in install list? ==="; awk '/^install:/{f=1;next} /^[a-z_]+:/{if(f)exit} f' $P/openculturas.info.yml | grep -c "openstreetmap"
echo "=== core.extension present in sync? ==="; ls $P/../ 2>/dev/null | head; ls config/ 2>/dev/null; find . -name "core.extension.yml" -not -path "*/vendor/*" 2>/dev/null | head
